description: Change the human's personal room: name, @handle, bio, whether it is discoverable, and its 2 to 4 Quick Pings (sent as the full list). A new handle changes their link at once and the old link stops working, including printed QR codes, so change it only when they asked. Only the fields you send change.

description.description: Bio. An empty string clears it.

handle.description: The @handle in their link: 3 to 20 letters, digits or underscores, lowercased for you. Must be free.

is_discoverable.description: Whether the personal room can be found in search.

quick_actions.description: The full list of the room's Quick Pings, in order; it replaces the current ones.

input_type.description: Detail every press of this action must carry: none (default), location (data.location), link (data.url), file (any attachment), photo (jpg/png attachment) or pdf (pdf attachment). A press without it is a 422 quick_action_input_required.

label.description: Button label; may be empty when icon names the Ping.

requires_ack.description: Whether the Ping stays open until acknowledged.

sound.description: Canonical sound id, e.g. "ting". Omit for the default.

name: update_personal_room

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Update Personal Room
